{{Youmay|the occupation of security officer|the [[Security Officer]] division of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]}}
{{Otheruses|security officer}}
{{Image}}
A '''security officer''' was responsible maintaining the safety and security of military personnel, vehicles, and installations. A security [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was often an integral part of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell.
